title: National Commission's Obligation to Dispose of Complaints

content.scenario: A consumer files a complaint with the National Commission regarding a defective product. The National Commission must dispose of the complaint with necessary modifications as per sections 35, 36, 37, 38, and 39 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
content.outcome: The National Commission disposes of the complaint in accordance with the provisions of sections 35, 36, 37, 38, and 39, with modifications as necessary.

user_queries: What is the National Commission's role in disposing of complaints?
How does the National Commission handle complaints under sections 35-39?
What modifications can the National Commission make while disposing of complaints?
